title: Some help rather than none
odia: ନାହିଁ ମାମୁଁ ଠଉଁ କଣା ମାମୁ ଭଲ
literal_meaning: A one-eyed maternal uncle is better than no maternal uncle.
explanation: The comparison expresses a preference for an imperfect resource over having none. Its family image assumes that an uncle can offer care or assistance. The point can be explained without treating disability as a measure of a person’s worth.
meaning_odia: କିଛି ସହାୟତା ନ ମିଳିବାଠାରୁ ସୀମିତ ସହାୟତା ମିଳିବା ଭଲ। ଏଥିରେ ଥିବା ଦୃଷ୍ଟିଦୋଷର ତୁଳନାକୁ ମଣିଷର ମୂଲ୍ୟ ମାପିବାର ମାନଦଣ୍ଡ କରିବା ଉଚିତ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: A reading group uses a small borrowed room while waiting for a larger meeting space. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
cultural_context: The historical-style dictionary explanation connects the maternal uncle with care for a nephew. The disability language is preserved as documented wording and identified as a dated comparison; no universal family practice is asserted.
